title: Paloma and the Hollow
author: Dominic Sterling
blurb: Odile Brightwater, an exiled storm-caller, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. But when a child arrives at the door speaking a language that predates kingdoms, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must steal back a soul sold to the court beneath the mountain before the last dragon-fire gutters out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
